{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Identify and remove refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Filter for completed orders only, excluding QA and refunded
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
filtered_df = df[completed_mask & ~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Check final shape
print(f"Final number of completed, non-QA, non-refunded orders: {filtered_df.shape[0]}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f"Conversion rates by channel:\n{conversion_rates}")

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
diff = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff}")"}
